apply_rules: Apply in the listed order on the RAW content (context=edit). Every "old" matches content.rendered exactly once at its turn (matches_in_live), except "replace_all" entries, which match exactly "expect_matches" times.

Edits with "spans_tags": true replace a whole <table> element: if "old" does not match the raw content exactly (raw line breaks between tags can differ), locate the single <table> element that contains "anchor" and replace that element with "new".

Every other old string sits inside one paragraph, list item or table cell and holds no HTML entity. The rendered content shows straight quotes (ש"ח, מ"ר) and no texturized characters, so raw and rendered text are expected to be identical inside a paragraph; re-check each old against the raw content right before applying.

tier 1 = sale-price alignment with the official list (conflicts, stale and unsourced sale figures); tier 2 = rent or other figures with no dated source. Applying tier 1 alone is valid (tier 2 olds do not overlap tier 1 results).
All or nothing per page: if any old does not match, write nothing. Re-fetch the page first; another session may have edited it. Data only: nothing here was applied.

Tier 2 under the CEO rule (7.10.2026): apply AFTER tier 1 (tier 1 is already live on this page), on the live content, in the listed order. Each tier-2 edit carries ceo_action (replaced = an official dated value now stands there, with its source_url; removed = number gone, sentence or cell kept; deleted = sentence, row or column gone) and ceo_note.
notes: Most per-room figures on this page are consistent with the official medians (3-5 rooms); the conflicts are the 2,400,000 city average repeated four times (lead, p@6560, the named platform in p@17787, FAQ) against the official all-rooms median 2,219,400. Not audited as claims (illustrations, not market statements): the 3%-7% asking-vs-closing condition (p@11323), the yield example 1,950,000 / 4,500-5,000 / 2.8%-3.1% and the 2,300,000 / 4,700 if-example (p@14845), the 3,100,000 / 2,600,000 / 500,000 new-vs-used if-example (p@20502), the seller example 2,250,000-2,400,000 / 2,690,000 / 2,290,000 (p@25473), the 150,000 gap example (p@25868), the 7%-12% if-example (p@27647). Remaining SUSPECT after the edits: tr@18704 (נס ציונה 3, March 2026, 2.5 rooms, 1,680,000) is an individual dated deal with an address. Portal names (מדדירות, Dirobot) stay only where old text kept word for word attributes kept figures (the rooms-table header, the FAQ 3-room answer, the Dirobot sentence); no new text names a portal. Name mapping: the page's 'קריית שרת' is matched to the official 'קרית שרת מערב' (part of it) and the cell names it; 'קריית עבודה' = 'קרית עבודה'; 'רסקו א׳' = 'רסקו א'. The official neighbourhood list holds 8 names (may be capped), so Tel Giborim, Jessy Cohen and Shikun Vatikim are pointed to street deals without saying no median exists. Rent, per-m2 and yield figures are kept where the page names the source (מדדירות, Realta, Scoutr, Dirobot) and shows its check date 6.6.2026; the yields of rows 3-5 are the page's own estimates (tier 2 candidates if a stricter reading is wanted). Seven tier-2 edits remove rule-of-thumb figures with no source (renovation 80,000-300,000 twice, 50,000-250,000 offer effect, 5%-12% floor premium, 8%-20% new-flat premium twice) and fix the 10 m2 example whose 350,000 top does not follow from 25,000-29,000 per m2. The JSON-LD script and the closing disclaimer are outside the audit and unchanged.

edits.old: מחירי דירות בחולון מתחילים בדרך כלל סביב 1,600,000-1,900,000 ₪ לדירות קטנות, עולים לאזור 1,900,000-2,500,000 ₪ בדירות 3-4 חדרים, ומגיעים גם ל-3,000,000-4,800,000 ₪ בדירות גדולות, פנטהאוזים, דירות חדשות או נכסים במיקומים חזקים במיוחד. לפי אתרי נתונים פרטיים ודינמיים, מחיר מבוקש ממוצע בעיר נע סביב 2,400,000 ₪, ומחיר למ״ר מוצג לא פעם סביב 25,000-29,000 ₪.
